quality.review_scope: Main protocol, Table 1 TDPA row, TEM label and corresponding SI optical/XRD panels visually checked. Common method applies to selected formulation; no independently identified batch or repeat count.
missing_fields: Table 1 particle-size metric and statistical meaning of +/-1.4 nm
conflicts: 16 mg Cs2CO3 corresponds to about 0.049 mmol formula units (about 0.098 mmol Cs atoms), whereas 0.1 mmol formula units would be about 32.6 mg. Source does not specify a Cs-atom basis for the parenthesis. Preserve both printed values and leave the basis unresolved; do not silently choose a correction.
Figure 1e axis and methods say solvodynamic diameter, whereas caption says radius. Do not use that DLS axis as an unambiguous alternative particle-size label without separate review.
Paper identifies orthorhombic phase but uses cubic facet nomenclature for convenience. This is not evidence of cubic crystal phase.
